summary: All six assigned saved PNGs were opened once. Desktop/mobile whole-course, page-start viewport and fig-25 captures show visible content, rendered equations, readable graph labels and no blocking clipping or overlap. Whole-page end visibility is supported by the saved DOM bounds. One nonblocking repeated-breadcrumb observation and the explicit preview/headless/accessibility limitations remain.

scope.method: Read and verify the bound D1350 JSON report. Hash the six declared PNGs and read their dimensions from PNG headers. Open exactly those six files once with functions.view_image. Assess their actual pixels and combine with the report's saved DOM geometry; no browser or renderer was started.
excluded: No source scans, original figure pixels, original SVG or additional images/crops opened.
No new original-figure/source/science approval; those passed judgments are reused.
No rerender, native execution, browser, network, database, Git, tests or paid calls.
No product/draft/figure/helper/counter changes, retention, push or formal handoff.

visibility.observations: Both complete course captures have the heading, prose sequence, rendered equations, one graph, its caption, repaired low-temperature limitation text, coefficient material and final derivation request. Neither surface is blank or an error-only page.

layoutClippingAndOverlap.observations: Desktop text is centered in a stable readable column. Mobile text and mathematical fragments wrap within the side margins. Figures, prose, captions and concept separators remain distinct. No obvious horizontal clipping, missing page end or incoherent overlap is observed. Saved DOM boxes fit the page widths and are ordered without vertical overlap.

equationDisplay.observations: The first pressure equation is rendered as mathematical typesetting in the desktop viewport capture. Whole captures visibly retain the pressure ratio, coefficient equation, 273 K reference and gamma/alpha inverse-interval line. Their equation shapes are present, horizontally contained and not raw LaTeX or replaced by blank/error boxes.
equationDisplay.limitation: The ratio and later coefficient details are covered by tall whole captures rather than separate native-scale equation close-ups. No assertion is made that every small numerator, denominator, subscript or Greek glyph was individually certified from this bounded batch.

figure25Display.observations: The actual desktop and mobile figure captures have readable p, T, zero, V1, V2 and V1<V2 labels with distinguishable subscripts. Both rays and dashed-to-solid portions remain visible; axis arrows and labels are not clipped or overlapped. The whole captures show the graph and its associated caption/prose in the course.

wholeEndReachability.observations: Both whole screenshots contain the final prose prompt and visible bottom whitespace. The last recorded paragraph bottom is inside each PNG's full-page height. Together with the saved 17-paragraph DOM PASS, this supports the saved document's complete, unclipped end.
wholeEndReachability.limitation: This is saved whole-document/DOM evidence, not a newly executed interactive scroll, headed application or production-navigation check.

viewportCaptureMeaning.observations: Both files named polarization-viewport actually show the page start. They support page-start typography and wrapping, not a dedicated polarization topic, repaired-glossary close-up or later full-equation certification. Mobile text continuing beyond the 844px viewport edge is not document clipping.

recovery.D1349Evidence: The direct assignment identifies D1349 CDP evidence; its rendered-font conclusion is also represented by D1350 per-label renderedFonts. No D1349 browser activity was repeated.

reusedEvidence.scienceSourceHistoryAndOriginalFigureApp: Reuse the original D1324 passed judgments and the affected-only text PASS closing F1. This saved display review does not replay them.

findings.followUp: Any breadcrumb deduplication belongs to separately authorized display work; no extra images, rerender or product edit is introduced here.

limitations.savedHeadlessOnly: Isolated offline headless course HTML; not production, headed acceptance or a live native/browser interaction.
limitations.tallPreview: Whole images are tall and may be scaled by the viewer. They establish overall layout and content/end visibility, not all-glyph native-scale readability.
limitations.fineGlyphs: No exhaustive fraction/subscript/Greek-character glyph certification and no new source-text comparison. Dedicated figure PNGs support the graph's actual labels.
limitations.accessibility: No full English accessibility certification. Pixels do not validate screen-reader reading order, equation speech, source-language Chinese metadata/ARIA, keyboard behavior or the entire accessibility tree.
limitations.ariaEvidence: D1350 reports fig-25 ariaLabel as Figure 25 and machineChineseAriaLabelsRetainedAndDisclosed as false in these views. This local observation does not certify every source/structural ARIA string is English; source-language limitations remain disclosed rather than inferred away.
limitations.viewportCoverage: The two polarization-viewport filenames are reused capture labels; their actual pixels are page-start views, not dedicated glossary captures.

usageAndState.chatDisposition: Remain open until retention/push readiness is separately confirmed or assigned. No new images or retention/push action is authorized by this report.
